output_md:
In commercial maintenance, missed SLAs are often seen as a people issue—technicians making mistakes or dispatchers bungling jobs. But I've found it's more about poor scheduling and data visibility. Without real-time access to travel times, technician skills, and job stacking, assigning tasks becomes hit-or-miss.

Imagine knowing exactly where each tech is, how long their commute will take, and if they have the right tools before you assign a job. That’s what I’ve been working towards with Slatebridge. It’s not magic; it’s just making sure we have the best information to make the best decisions every time.

So, operations managers, do you see your missed SLAs as a data or people problem? Share your thoughts below.
